statement: The existing ControlPlaneSnapshotOwner classifies a terminal priority ADD or REPLACE whose exact captured target service remains transitional as stale, reconciles topology and operation-ledger tables through canonical complete-table repair, becomes fresh only after the authoritative target is ACTIVE, never synthesizes ACTIVE or leader topology from operation evidence, and passes a production-path red-on-revert guard three consecutive times.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Extend ControlPlaneSnapshotOwner and its existing authoritative repair path. Do not create a second snapshot owner, topology writer, or admission bypass.

A terminal operation may trigger authoritative reconciliation only when its exact captured target row remains pending, creating, or syncing on a currently blocked priority partition. It must never synthesize ACTIVE, voter, address, leader, or source-retirement state.

Refresh partitions, services, tables, and replica_operations through the canonical gateway and complete-table receipts. If authoritative rows remain contradictory after repair, keep the snapshot stale.
Do not change MovieLens schema admission, stability budgets, deadlines, rebalancer cadence, schema, preload, loader batch, split policy, affinity scoring, or exact-result predicates.
Run npm run model:contracts and use model:architecture/contracts/core-system-logic.md for the owner-boundary attempt.
